data.name: Frightful Strikes
data.description: As a swift action once per bloodrage, you can empower your melee attacks with fear. For 1 round, creatures you hit with your melee attacks become shaken. Creatures who are already shaken become frightened, though this does not stack with the frightful charger ability.
